description: Search the brand’s direct-message inbox two ways at once: WORDS inside the messages (whole words, any case or accent; every word must be in one message) and the PERSON (part of their name, handle or number). Covers WhatsApp, Messenger and Instagram, Telegram, SMS, iMessage, LINE, Slack, Discord, email, the domain inbox and call transcripts; X only with includeX (every X message read is billed). direction:"outgoing" finds how the brand itself writes, e.g. to teach an AI its tone. Each hit carries channel + conversationId (for manage_inbox_conversation and reply_to_inbox_item via list_inbox) and up to 3 matching messages. A channel that could not be read is named in notes, never counted as "no match". Read-only, 0 credits (X billed only when included).

channels.description: limit to these: whatsapp, meta, telegram, sms, imessage, line, slack, discord, email, domain_mail, call, x

direction.description: which messages to search: any (default), incoming (from people), outgoing (from the brand)

includeX.description: also search X direct messages (billed per message read)

maxThreads.description: how many of the newest conversations to read for words (0-100, default 40); a name or number matches every conversation listed

query.description: words to find in messages, or part of a name, @handle or phone number

name: search_inbox
title: Search the inbox
